results.title: [GA4] Recommended events - Analytics Help
results.markdown:
Title: [GA4] Recommended events - Analytics Help

URL Source: https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9267735

Markdown Content:
Adding these events to your website or mobile app helps you measure additional features and behavior as well as generate more useful reports, and build [suggested audiences](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/10427338). Because these events require additional context to be meaningful, they're not sent automatically.

Use the links in this article to see the prescribed parameters for each event. You should send recommended events with their prescribed parameters to get the most details in your reports and to benefit from future features and integrations as they become available.

To learn how to set up a recommended event on your website, see [Set up events](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/events). For your app project, see [Log events](https://firebase.google.com/docs/analytics/events?platform=ios).The data from these events automatically update predefined dimensions and metrics so you can analyze the data in your reports.

## [](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9267735)For all properties

We recommend these events to all customers in all business verticals. Later sections in this article include some of these events when we recommend sending the events for the given use case.

| Event | Trigger when a user... |
| --- | --- |
| [ad_impression](https://firebase.google.com/docs/analytics/measure-ad-revenue) | sees an advertisement, for apps only |
| [earn_virtual_currency](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#earn_virtual_currency) | earns virtual currency (coins, gems, tokens, etc.) |
| [generate_lead](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#generate_lead) | submits a form or a request for information |
| [join_group](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#join_group) | joins a group |
| [login](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#login) | logs in |
| [purchase](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#purchase) | completes a purchase |
| [refund](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#refund) | receives a refund |
| [search](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#search) | searches your website or app |
| [select_content](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#select_content) | selects content on your website or app |
| [share](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#share) | shares content from your website or app |
| [sign_up](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#sign_up) | signs up for an account on your website or app |
| [spend_virtual_currency](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#spend_virtual_currency) | spends virtual currency (coins, gems, tokens, etc.) |
| [tutorial_begin](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#tutorial_begin) | begins a tutorial during an on-boarding process |
| [tutorial_complete](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#tutorial_complete) | completes a tutorial during an on-boarding process |

## [](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9267735)For online sales

We recommend these events when you want to measure sales on your site or app. They're useful for **retail**, **ecommerce**, **education**, **real estate**, and **travel**. Sending the events populates [the _Ecommerce purchases_ report](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9786881#ecommerce-purchases). To learn more about these events, see [Measure ecommerce](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/ecommerce) for your website. View [Measure ecommerce (app)](https://firebase.google.com/docs/analytics/measure-ecommerce) for events in your app project.

| Event | Trigger when a user... |
| --- | --- |
| [add_payment_info](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#add_payment_info) | submits their payment information during checkout |
| [add_shipping_info](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#add_shipping_info) | submits their shipping information during checkout |
| [add_to_cart](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#add_to_cart) | adds items to their shopping cart |
| [add_to_wishlist](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#add_to_wishlist) | adds items to their wishlist |
| [begin_checkout](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#begin_checkout) | begins checkout |
| [purchase](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#purchase) | completes a purchase |
| [refund](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#refund) | receives a refund |
| [remove_from_cart](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#remove_from_cart) | removes items from their shopping cart |
| [select_item](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#select_item) | selects an item from a list of items or offerings |
| [select_promotion](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#select_promotion) | selects a promotion |
| [view_cart](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#view_cart) | views their shopping cart |
| [view_item](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#view_item) | views an item |
| [view_item_list](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#view_item_list) | views a list of items or offerings |
| [view_promotion](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events#view_promotion) | views a promotion on your website or app |

## [](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9267735)For lead generation

We recommend these events when you want to measure the full lead generation funnel for online and offline activity. They're useful for business-to-business sales, automotive sales, insurance sales, or generally for when conversions occur offline. Sending these events populates the [Lead acquisition report](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/16376749).

**Event****Trigger when a user...**
[generate_lead](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/collection/ga4/reference/events?client_type=gtag#generate_lead)submits a form online or submits information offline
